OVMS_NOT_READY.user_message: Start OpenVINO Model Server for the agent model, then try again.
next_steps: Invoke intel-ovms-agentic-setup with user approval (-Approve; add -Pull on first download; -Profile agent for Hermes agent chat).
When the server is up, invoke intel-agent-provider-config (configure-hermes-ovms) with -Approve.

MODEL_ADVERTISED_MISMATCH.user_message: The model running on port 8000 is not the one this workflow expects.
next_steps: Stop the wrong server or use -ApproveStopOvms after you approve.
Start OVMS with the correct profile, then confirm names at http://localhost:8000/v3/models.

PORT_CONFLICT.user_message: Port 8000 is already in use by another process.
next_steps: Stop the other OVMS instance or approve stopping it with -ApproveStopOvms.
Re-run OVMS setup for the model you want.

DISK_INSUFFICIENT.user_message: There is not enough free disk space for the model download.
next_steps: Free space under your user OVMS folder volume.

RETRY_PULL_REQUIRES_APPROVAL.user_message: A model download needs your explicit approval to retry or resume.
next_steps: Confirm with the user, then invoke intel-ovms-agentic-setup again with -Approve, -ApproveRetryPull, and -Pull.

PULL_IN_PROGRESS.user_message: Another model download may already be in progress.
next_steps: Wait for the other download to finish, or clear stale state if no download is running.

intel-ovms-agentic-setup: Invoke the intel-ovms-agentic-setup skill with -Approve (add -Pull on first model download).
intel-ovms-agentic-setup-agent-profile: Invoke intel-ovms-agentic-setup with -Approve -Profile agent (add -Pull to download the large model).
If port 8000 still serves the small model, add -ApproveStopOvms after the user approves stopping it.
intel-devkit-install: Invoke the intel-devkit-install skill with -Approve from an elevated PowerShell session (Dev Kit Setup; not OVMS-only).
intel-devkit-ovms-slice-fetch: Invoke the intel-devkit-ovms-slice-fetch skill with -Approve to sparse-clone Windows_Software_Installation/OVMS into the Dev Kit install root.
Then invoke intel-ovms-agentic-setup with -Approve (add -Pull on first model download).
intel-devkit-verify: Invoke intel-devkit-verify as the standard user (not elevated) to confirm OpenVINO GenAI and OVMS paths.
intel-agent-provider-config: Optional: invoke intel-agent-provider-config with -Approve to stage Hermes (or OpenClaw) settings for http://localhost:8000/v3.
Follow local_provider_handoff in the skill JSON (hermes model / new chat); provider switch is not automatic.
openvino-coding-assistant: Invoke openvino-coding-assistant via invoke-openvino-coding-assistant-setup.ps1. If Muse-Glimmer or Qwen3.6 is already on port 8000, use -Approve -Apply and do not pass -Pull. Pass -Pull only when neither model is advertised.
Reload VS Code and select the OVMS model that was added in Continue (not auto-default).
